question: What specific liṅga forms and proportions are prescribed for the twice-born?
premises: The stream-liṅga is named as a form.
A one-edged form is also included.
Proportions of two, three parts and so on are specified.
inference: The twice-born should fashion the stream-liṅga and the one-edged liṅga with divisions of two, three parts and so on.
uncertainties: The precise geometric meaning of ekāśra here is context-dependent.
plain_english: The twice-born should make the stream-liṅga and the one-edged liṅga with divisions of two, three parts and so forth.
